_what: Shopify /products.json catalog fixtures for tests/test_wide_signal_text.py. NO network was used to build these. Each product object was lifted verbatim from the embedded <script type="application/json" id="ProductJson-..."> blob of the corresponding CACHED PDP under _proof/html/ (filename = sha1('curl_cffi|' + url).hexdigest() + '.html'), which Shopify themes render with the SAME product object the {pdp}.js endpoint returns.
_transform: description -> body_html and type -> product_type (the /products.json envelope uses those names; the embedded/.js envelope uses the former). Values byte-identical.

variant price: the embedded/.js envelope is INTEGER MINOR UNITS, /products.json is a DECIMAL STRING. Divided by 10**minor_unit for the store's currency and rendered as a fixed-point string (BHD/OMR 3dp, AED 2dp). No other numeric change.

images/media/featured_image/selling_plan_groups/quantity_rule dropped (bulk, unused by _match_shopify_product) so the fixture stays a few KB. Every field the code under test reads (title/handle/vendor/product_type/tags/body_html/variants[].title|price|available) is unmodified real data.
_store_currency added: the envelope key _fetch_shopify_catalog stamps on the catalog. Value = the registry_currency recorded for that domain in _proof/sweep2_curl_cffi.jsonl.

products.title: Perfumusk
products.why:
GAIN/size. Product title 'Perfumusk' carries NO ml token and the single variant is 'Default Title', so the NARROW signal text yields no size. The real body_html carries '

100 ml

'. Widened capture recovers size=100ml.

products.title: ODYSSEY TYRANT SPECIAL EDITION
products.why: GAIN/concentration+size. Title 'ODYSSEY TYRANT SPECIAL EDITION' carries neither axis; the real tags carry 'edp for her' and the real body_html opens 'Eau De Parfum 100ml'. Widened capture recovers concentration=EDP and size=100ml.

products.title: MUSK 07 EDP + BODY LOTION GIFT SET
products.why: ADVERSARIAL/cross-contamination. A GIFT SET whose real body_html lists TWO different items at TWO different sizes - 'Musk 07 Extrait de Parfum - 50ml' and 'Musk 07 Body Lotion - 300ml'. A naive widened capture takes sorted({'50','300'})[0] = '300' (STRING sort) and would ship the BODY LOTION's 300ml as the fragrance size. Pins the ambiguity-abstention rule.
